clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Field Marshal Snowfall gathers provisions and equipment for the Grand Alliance's war effort. Champions can trade commendation signets for field rations, bandages, and combat supplies. The stockpiles keep those working on the home front equipped for coming conflicts.

Field Marshal Snowfall organizes the flow of materials as one of the Alliance's primary quartermasters in Ironforge. Armies need more than courage; they also need steady supplies for the fronts. Couriers and heroes bring commendation signets earned through civic service, and Snowfall trades them for survival rations and tactical gear.

Royal heralds offer public honor and civic standing for commendation signets. Snowfall offers another choice: trade five signets for field gear, without pomp, glory, or official recognition. The exchange gives soldiers and volunteers practical goods to help keep them alive when marching into hostile lands.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, here for additional supplies for yourself, are you? Well, I can certainly understand the need for additional materiel... Just take a look around if you need any proof.

I'll issue you some additional supplies, but you'll need to give me an appropriate number of commendation signets in exchange. You won't receive any recognition for surrendering the signets in this manner, but you might find something useful that will help keep you alive when battle is finally upon us.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well then, it's settled; here are your supplies, adventurer. If you wish to do an additional exchange, then I am prepared to authorize it. Just give me the word and I'll make it happen.
Keep up the good work, friend. We need all the materiel we can muster if we're going to win this thing. If we all do our part, then victory shall be ours for the taking!
